verses.gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਬਾਬਾ ਗਇਆ ਬਗਦਾਦਿ ਨੋ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਕੀਆ ਅਸਥਾਨਾ।
verses.translit_en: fir baabaa giaa bagadhaadh no baahar jai keeaa asathaanaa|

en.bdb: From Mecca Baba went to Baghdad and stayed outside the city.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਬਾਬਾ ਅਕਾਲ ਰੂਪੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਰਬਾਬੀ ਮਰਦਾਨਾ।
verses.translit_en: eik baabaa akaal roop dhoojaa rabaabee maradhaanaa|

en.bdb: Firstly, Baba himself was in the form of Timeless and secondly, he had his companion Mardana, the rebeck player.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਿਤੀ ਬਾਂਗਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਿ ਕਰਿ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਹੋਆ ਜਹਾਨਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhitee baa(n)g nivaaj kar su(n)n samaan hoaa jahaanaa|

en.bdb: For namaz (in his own style), Baba gave call, listening to which the whole world went into absolute silence.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨ ਮੁੰਨਿ ਨਗਰੀ ਭਈ ਦੇਖਿ ਪੀਰ ਭਇਆ ਹੈਰਾਨਾ।
verses.translit_en: su(n)n mu(n)n nagaree bhiee dhekh peer bhiaa hairaanaa|

en.bdb: The whole city became quiet and lo! to behold it, the pir (of the town) also got wonderstruck.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੇਖੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਲਗਾਇ ਕਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਫਕੀਰੁ ਵਡਾ ਮਸਤਾਨਾ।
verses.translit_en: vekhai dhiaan lagai kar ik fakeer vaddaa masataanaa|

en.bdb: Observing minutely he found (in the form of Baba Nanak) an exhilerated faquir.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੁਛਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਕੈ ਦਸਤਗੀਰ ਕਉਣ ਫਕੀਰੁ ਕਿਸ ਕਾ ਘਰਿਆਨਾ।
verses.translit_en: puchhiaa fir kai dhasatageer kaun fakeer kis kaa ghariaanaa|

en.bdb: Pir Dastegir asked him, which category of faquir you belong to and what is your parentage.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਲਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਇਆ ਰਬੁ ਫਕੀਰੁ ਇਕੋ ਪਹਿਚਾਨਾ।
verses.translit_en: naanak kal vich aaiaa rab fakeer iko pahichaanaa|

en.bdb: (Mardana told) He is Nanak, who has come into kaliyug, and, he recognises God and His faquirs as one.
He is known in all the directions besides earth and sky.
